zh.title: 墨记
zh.description: 把随手记下的内容和待办放在一起，默认保存在手机本地。
highlights: 笔记支持搜索、标签、置顶和回收站
写 Markdown 时可以预览，也能设置提醒
笔记与待办可通过备份导出、导入迁移

caseStudy.scenario: 想做一个纯净无广告、打开就能快速记录的笔记和待办软件。
caseStudy.experience: 把笔记、待办和备份放在一起，默认在手机本地保存，也保留 Markdown 预览。
caseStudy.tradeoff: 更新中补过长说明显示不全等细节，也增加了应用内更新，尽量让功能增加后依然好用。

en.title: Moji-Notes
en.description: Notes and to-dos together, saved locally on your phone by default.
highlights: Search, tags, pinning, and a recycle bin for notes
Markdown preview and reminders
Backup export and import for moving your data

caseStudy.scenario: To make a clean, ad-free app for quick notes and to-dos.
caseStudy.experience: Notes, tasks, and backups in one place, with local storage and Markdown preview.
caseStudy.tradeoff: Updates addressed clipped long descriptions and added in-app updating, keeping growing features easy to use.

zh.title: Moji-Web
zh.description: 把墨记的记录习惯带到浏览器，让电脑和手机屏幕各有合适的布局。
highlights: 笔记、待办与标签在浏览器本地保存
宽屏可并排编辑和预览 Markdown
备份格式与安卓端一致，可导出与导入

caseStudy.scenario: 在电脑上写较长的笔记，同时查看排版；换到窄屏时，列表和导航会重新排列。
caseStudy.experience: 保留笔记与待办的组织方式，界面按浏览器屏幕调整，而不是直接照搬手机页面。
caseStudy.tradeoff: 浏览器提醒依赖页面保持打开；页面关闭后的提醒能力与安卓端不同。

en.title: Moji-Web
en.description: Moji-Notes in your browser, with layouts that fit both desktop and phone screens.
highlights: Notes, tasks, and tags stored locally in the browser
Side-by-side Markdown editing and preview on wide screens
Backup files compatible with the Android app

caseStudy.scenario: Write a longer note on a computer with a live preview, then use the same organization on a narrow screen.
caseStudy.experience: Keep the note and task workflow while adapting the interface to the browser’s available space.
caseStudy.tradeoff: Browser reminders require the page to stay open; closed-page reminders differ from the Android app.

zh.title: 方寸食光
zh.description: 为我的世界基岩版增添料理、餐具与场景摆件，让搭建的空间更有生活气息。
highlights: 料理、餐具以及医疗、家居等多类场景摆件
在创造模式中摆放和收回，丰富场景搭建

caseStudy.scenario: 想丰富我的世界的游戏内容，给自己搭建的场景增加更多可摆放的细节。
caseStudy.experience: 从料理、餐具扩展到医疗和家居设备，把不同主题的摆件放进同一个附加包。
caseStudy.tradeoff: 大型摆件要兼顾显示、占地和收回操作。更新记录中持续调整这些细节，同时保留旧存档规则。

en.title: Food & Table
en.description: Food, tableware, and decorative props that bring more everyday detail to Minecraft Bedrock builds.
highlights: Food, tableware, medical equipment, and home props
Place and collect decorations in Creative mode

caseStudy.scenario: To enrich Minecraft with more placeable details for the scenes I build.
caseStudy.experience: A single add-on that grows from food and tableware into medical, home, and other themed props.
caseStudy.tradeoff: Large props must balance appearance, occupied space, and collection controls. Updates refine these details while preserving existing save rules.
